verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a full public API (Records, Workflows, Templates) with OAuth2 auth, webhooks, and explicit workflow-launch endpoints for generating and sending contracts programmatically, backed by developer docs and getting-started guides. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard paths), independent third-party hands-on confirmation of the API (community evidence is about the broader product, not the API specifically), and concrete code samples/SDKs in the evidence pack.
